limitations: Conversions are platform-attributed. Actual bookings and true customer acquisition cost are not available in this data.
Conversions are reported per conversion basis and are never totalled across bases.
Findings are threshold-based. No statistical significance test was performed.
Findings describe what changed and do not establish causes.
Reporting dates are in each account's own timezone.
Recent days can be restated as late conversions are reported.
Comparisons have different windows and are reported separately, not combined.
Finding groups show shared metric inputs and do not establish causes.
A persistence assessment never confirms that an issue has resolved.

metric_definitions.absolute_change: current - baseline. Null when either value is null.
metric_definitions.cost_per_platform_attributed_conversion: spend / platform-attributed conversions. Null when conversions are zero. A proxy, not true customer acquisition cost.
metric_definitions.cpc: spend / clicks. Null when clicks are zero.
metric_definitions.ctr: clicks / impressions, as a fraction. Null when impressions are zero.
metric_definitions.noise_guard: A change clears the guard when |ln(current / baseline)| >= width * sqrt(1/B + 1/C), where B and C are platform-attributed conversion counts. A heuristic, not a significance test or confidence interval.
metric_definitions.percent_change: (current - baseline) / baseline, in percent. Null when the baseline is zero or null.
metric_definitions.platform_attributed_conversion_rate: platform-attributed conversions / clicks, as a fraction. Null when clicks are zero. Can include view-through credit.
metric_definitions.platform_attributed_roas: platform-reported conversion value / spend. Null when spend is zero. Not realized return.
